evidence.reason: The deadline is computed at line 847 but is never passed into `controller.drain_check`; the runbook only reads the clock after the call returns. A drain scan that probes multiple recorded runs can therefore block past the remaining deadline, and capping the subsequent sleep cannot bound that work. Passing the remaining time into the scan and treating expired, unobserved work as unresolved preserves the existing fail-stop behavior and is a routine correctness repair.
